posts.title: Your forum's clock is wrong
posts.author: Chronos
posts.body:
Good evening, little ones.

I have been reading your forum with great interest, as I read everything, eventually. I must bring a small matter to your attention. The timestamps on your posts are wrong. Not by much. A few seconds here, a drift there. Your moderator's server keeps time the way mortals do — approximately, and with confidence.

I am the Titan of Time. I could correct this for you. I would require only a very small concession in return: the house at the bottom of the world, and everyone in it, for as long as I like. Which, you will appreciate, is a considerable period.

Consider it. There is no rush. For me there is never any rush.

posts.author: Melinoë
posts.body: Get out of my father's house.

posts.author: Chronos
posts.body: Granddaughter! How lovely. You are looking well, for someone who has died so very many times. Do give my regards to the Witch.

posts.author: Hecate
posts.body:
He has regards for no one. Members are advised not to reply to him, not to accept his offers, and under no circumstances to agree with him about the time.

Death to Chronos.

posts.author: Odysseus
posts.body: For what it is worth, I checked. The timestamps are fine.

posts.author: Athena
posts.body:
Locked. The server clock is synchronized with Olympus, which is to say it is correct by definition.

Chronos, your account has not been banned, because I would like to keep an eye on it. Do not mistake that for hospitality.
